title: Mine arrived damaged.
text: Mine arrived damaged.. I'm rating this at 3 stars since one of the four clamps was broken upon arrival.  Except for that, this works really well as a cleaning station (filled with alcohol) for resin 3D prints.  The inner part can be easily lifted up and down and rotated to help thoroughly clean prints.  When done, just snap the lid back on and save for next time.  When the alcohol gets too dirty/cloudy, set it out in direct sun to cure the resin debris, then pour it through a filter and you have (mostly) clean alcohol.  To improve this product (I realize it's made for pickles, lol) I would like the plastic to be perfectly transparent, not clear-ish, and a bit sturdier so as not to be easily broken...as mine was during shipping.
